rationale: Max scenario net load is t1=72, t2=77, t3=69. Adding 8 MW reserve requires thermal generation of 80, 85, 77. Cheapest unit g1 (18/MWh, max 70) is dispatched at its 70 MW max each period; the remainder (10, 15, 7) is served by g2 within its 5-45 MW limits. Margin equals reserve (8 MW) in each period, and total cost is 18*(70+70+70) + 36*(10+15+7) = 3780 + 1152 = 4932.
